text:
nina: quick note  bringing a new int8 profile for sakura-v2 into staging. smoke runs show two locale regressions we should triage.

cheng: what are we seeing? short repro?

nina: two buckets: (A) ja->en polite/honorific prompts lose keigo markers (tone shift). (B) ar<->en mixed-direction lines sometimes reverse parentheses/brackets and drop trailing punctuation.

alec: only on int8 or seen on fp32 too?

nina: only failing on int8 build with matmul-v3 + fused-softmax enabled. fp32 and our q4 runs look fine.

park: can you paste metric deltas?

nina: small sample from the politeness-preserve eval (subset of onboard smoke):

```
baseline fp32: BLEU=33.2, COMET=0.51
int8 matmul-v3: BLEU=28.1, COMET=0.21
delta: BLEU -5.1, COMET -0.30
```

nina: example ja input: "\u5148\u751f\u3001\u3054\u7d39\u4ecb\u3054\u3081\u305b\u3067\u3059\u304b\u3002"
nina: fp32 out: "Excuse me, professor, may I introduce myself? (polite)"
nina: int8 out: "Can I introduce myself, professor?"  <-- loses politeness markers / rephrasing

qa: tokenization counts differ?

nina: token counts same, but generation traces show occasional inserted 0 token between punctuation and adjacent token in mixed-direction contexts.

alec: that rings alarm bells about sampling/saturation or an index aliasing issue. Got a raw id diff?

nina: yes, trace snippet (shortened):

```
fp32 ids: [4521, 12, 988, 4320]
int8 ids: [4521, 12, 0, 988, 4320]
```

nina: int8 inserted a 0 before the token that holds the opening bracket in the arabic cases, causing detok to treat it as separate and bidi reorder to flip paren order.

park: arabic example?

nina: src: "\u0623\u0647\u0644\u0627 \u0623\u0633\u062a\u0637\u0627\u0639 \u0028API\u0029 \u0627\u0644\u0623\u064a\u0627\u062a\u061f"

nina: fp32: "Can I use (API) now?"
nina: int8: ")API( now?"  <-- bracket order flipped, sometimes punctuation gone

cheng: could this be a detokenizer bug triggered by a nul token in the stream? Where does 0 originate in the int8 pass?

alec: candidates: quantized-softmax underflow/overlap producing a near-zero token id, KV-cache pointer misalignment when we transpose for matmul-v3, or a postprocess trimming off sequence starts incorrectly.

qa: i ran a quick local repro with `scripts/locale_repro.sh --model sakura-v2 --profile int8-v3 --cases ja-keigo,ar-brackets` and attached compact trace:

```
[repro] model=sakura-v2 int8-v3
[repro] case=ar-brackets
[repro] sampled_ids: ... 3321, 40, 0, 2219, ...
[repro] detok => ")API(" ...
```

ops-bot: deployment staging-int8-2026-03-21-172500 applied

park: mitigation: add a quick sanitizer in detok that collapses 0 tokens and drops nul-like markers before bidi processing. low-risk guard until root cause fixed.

alec: do that, but also we need kernel-level traces. I'll run a svmap+asan pass over matmul-v3 with mixed-dir sequences to check misaligned loads.

cheng: i'll add two smoke tests to the model-onboard suite: 1) ja-keigo politeness preservation (exact-match checks for honorific markers) 2) ar-bracket bidi-preserve (parens orientation + trailing punctuation presence). block int8 rollouts on failure.

nina: opened ML ticket ML-1749 with sample files and failed traces (link: https://redwood-internal/p/ML-1749). included minimal failing inputs and metrics.

alec: quick hypothesis: when we transpose attention states for matmul-v3 we changed the stride order; in long prefixes the pointer arithmetic sometimes leaves a zeroed slot that gets sampled. will confirm.

park: if kernel rollback is needed, we should prepare a rollback patch for int8 matmul and gate it behind the new smoke tests.

qa: i'll prepare a harness to run keigo and bidi tests on every int8 candidate and add it to the preflight CI.

nina: thanks. action items: alec (kernel svmap + asan trace), park (detok sanitizer PR), cheng (smoke tests + CI gating), qa (harness + repro scripts). i'll coordinate ML-1749 and paste updates here. :pray:

cheng: bumping this to high priority for today. will post results in 3-4 hours.

nina: ack. will keep thread live with traces.
